description.value: BeaverTails is an iconic Canadian pastry chain, famous for hand-stretched whole-wheat pastries fried to order and topped with a wide range of sweet or savory options. The Victoria location on Broughton Street sits close to the Inner Harbour, one of the city's busiest cycling and tourist corridors. Beyond pastries, the menu includes poutines, BeaverDogs, lemonades, and hot chocolate — a solid quick-fuel stop on a ride through downtown Victoria.
